critical_code_review_comments: SupplierCasePage.js: readOnly / isGymViewer is driven purely by localStorage.getItem('token') (line 599). The ?view=site query param is never actually parsed. Any logged-in user (not just MOD site viewers) that lands on a supplier case URL is forced into read-only. Works for the current use case but the ?view=site contract is misleading — consider parsing the query param OR renaming the constant. Not a bug for this test.

IssueDetailPanel.js line 858: The 'Shared with' chips row only renders when supplier_case.notify_emails.length > 1. Legacy MOD faults created before the shared-thread backend logic have notify_emails=[] and therefore never show the chips — expected but worth flagging so QA doesn't get confused when validating on old data.
detail-dio-pill-<id> testid is conditional (only when the fault has been escalated to DIO). Consider always rendering the wrapper with data-testid for stable QA hooks even when 'not escalated'.
